correctness.rationale: For all finite generalized quadrangles s,t>=2, the geometric axioms imply an exact one-step triple type reduction to equality, sorts, incidences and collinearity/concurrency of pairs. Explicit cardinality formulas prove all relevant pair-extension masks positive and independent of s,t; the dual and mixed cases cover both sorts. Back-and-forth yields exactly 84 rank-one triple, 10 rank-two pair, 2 rank-three singleton, and one rank-four sentence type. Two rank-five formulas detect s>=3 and t>=3, and four classical models realize all combinations. The package verifier independently enumerates complete rank-four tuple-extension types for four examples, including both asymmetric order orientations, and checks their defining axioms. Finite tests are not mistaken for the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The exact 84/10/2/1 local type spectrum supplies a complete short-depth logical invariant for a natural finite incidence-geometry family with varying two-sided degrees and potentially nonclassical automorphisms. The theorem eliminates symmetry and the distance-regularity hypothesis and works in the strictly stronger named-sort language, so it is not a simple restatement of an earlier symmetric uncoloured theorem. The sharp first-visible rank is five and independently detects the two order parameters, giving four realized logical boundary types. No claim of a full rank-five classification is made.
